label: 影片 26
theme: 《穿著 Prada 的惡魔 2》卡司猜電影拍攝地
themeEn: Does 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' Cast Know Their Film Locations?

ex.en: I know what's the fastest way back to the consulate, but I hate this hill.
ex.zh: 我知道回領事館最快的路，但我討厭這座坡。

tips.t: the consulate 領事館（辦簽證題）；embassy＝大使館。

ex.en: I picked up so much momentum so fast. Heart pounding. Oh my gosh.
ex.zh: 我一下子就衝得好快。心臟狂跳。天啊。

tips.t: gain／lose momentum 聲勢增強／減弱（業績、專案常用）。

ex.en: She's the most magical hug of a human being. And she's so generous. She's so warm.
ex.zh: 她的擁抱是全世界最神奇的。她非常大方。非常溫暖。

tips.t: a generous donation 慷慨的捐款；generous portions 份量很多（餐廳評論）。

ex.en: She has the most amazing energy. Just really, really gracious.
ex.zh: 她有最棒的能量。真的真的非常親切。

tips.t: a gracious host 親切的主人。

ex.en: So, this was the Georgia O'Keeffe property, I think, in the middle of nowhere, the New Mexican desert.
ex.zh: 這是 Georgia O'Keeffe 的莊園，我想，在新墨西哥沙漠的荒郊野外。

tips.t: property manager 物業經理；rental property 出租房產（Part 7 租屋廣告）。

ex.en: To my ranch with friends. You should come. It was astonishingly beautiful.
ex.zh: 「去我的牧場，和朋友們一起。你應該來。」那裡美得驚人。

ex.en: Like, I think the New Mexican skies are just this vast, this mythic story space to make that movie. It was wild. Jesus. I mean, um oh.
ex.zh: 我覺得新墨西哥的天空就是這麼遼闊，是拍那部電影最神話般的故事空間。太狂了。天啊。我是說，嗯，喔。

tips.t: the vast majority of 絕大多數的～（報告題常見）。

pos.m: 不太可能的，難以置信的

ex.en: And they did it more than once. Yeah. It's an amazing spot. It's almost improbable.
ex.zh: 結果他們拍了不只一次。對。那是個很棒的地方。幾乎令人難以置信。

ex.en: We shot in indoors, in England.
ex.zh: 我們是在英國的室內拍的。

tips.t: indoors adv. vs. indoor adj.（indoor pool 室內泳池；Part 5 詞性題）。

ex.en: I was always an enormous fan, although we are not terribly apart you know, huge age difference.
ex.zh: 我一直都是她的超級粉絲，雖然我們年紀沒有差很多，你知道，巨大的年齡差距。

tips.t: an enormous success 巨大的成功。

ex.en: I watched it again last night cuz the kids wanted to finish it last night before they come to the premiere.
ex.zh: 我昨晚又看了一次，因為孩子們想在來首映會之前把它看完。

tips.t: the world premiere 全球首映；attend the premiere 出席首映會。

ex.en: Pat Field had put me in these lovely gloves and I was wearing my own uh Prada shoes that I brought because sometimes uh in a film you the budget doesn't quite stretch and so you provide some of your own favorite accessories.
ex.zh: Pat Field 讓我戴上這雙好美的手套，我穿的是我自己帶去的 Prada 鞋，因為有時候拍電影預算不太夠，所以你會提供一些自己最愛的配件。

tips.t: over budget 超出預算；within budget 在預算內；budget proposal 預算提案。

pos.m: 外燴的，由餐飲業者提供的

ex.en: I was kind of too nervous and I'd have to say that French film crews provide a gorgeous catered lunch. With wine? With wine.
ex.zh: 我那時有點太緊張了，而我得說法國的電影劇組會提供超豐盛的外燴午餐。配酒嗎？配酒。

tips.t: catered lunch 外燴午餐；catering service 外燴服務（活動籌備題必考）。

ex.en: That's the exterior of the restaurant in Big Night.
ex.zh: 那是《大餐（Big Night）》裡那家餐廳的外觀。

tips.t: the exterior of the building 建築外觀（反義 interior 室內）。

ex.en: It had to be like perfect and effortless. And sometimes it's not.
ex.zh: 它得做得完美又毫不費力，而有時候並不是這樣。

tips.t: make it look effortless 讓它看起來毫不費力。
